wiki.title: Robgoblins
wiki.text:
Robgoblins are a race of goblin-like creatures. They are small creatures that live primarily in camps with other robgoblins. They have an affinity for destruction, explosives, magic and stealing.

Many robgoblins are enemies, but there are also robgoblin NPCs and questgivers.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of robgoblins in two locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Robgoblins can be found in Sacred Grove. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses. They can also be found in Sunstone Valley, although there are several differences in these two cousins. Such include a red skin tone and a default occupation as a scrapsmith. There is a scrapsmith camp just outside of the hostile area controlled by these small creatures.
